title: Operators create a client account, grant its products and invite the owner from the CRM
description:
What exists today (surveyed 2026-10-31): the customer BFF serves POST /accounts (accounts/bff.ts, CREATE_ACCOUNT_PATH) and the CRM's src/AccountsView.tsx has a working self-service create form that kanbus-4b7ade will remove; the portal UI still says creating a workspace is not yet available (src/portal/RequestAccess.tsx; story kanbus-b09c91). Every existing path makes the signed-in caller the owner and entitles only the calling product. Nothing lets an operator create an account for a client, so a sales-led account (the invoiced-billing case in kanbus-a78bcdbc) has no path at all, and the open gaps stand: no operator can grant a product (kanbus-592fbb route exists, API Gateway policy held), sites cannot invite members (kanbus-b2ddb4, kanbus-031445).

As an operator, I set up a client's account from the CRM so that a client who never visits the portal can have an account, the right site products and an invited owner.

Feature: Operator account setup
  Scenario: Create a client account
    Given an operator holding a new reviewed permission accounts:admin:write
    When they create an account with a name and an operation key
    Then the account document is created with no memberships yet, a creation fingerprint naming the operator grant as creator, and an audit entry; a retry with the same key returns the same account
  Scenario: Grant products
    When the operator grants papyrus-<site> products and optionally cyclotron
    Then each entitlement is set through the existing setEntitlement route (kanbus-592fbb) with audit, and billing is untouched
  Scenario: Invite the owner
    When the operator invites an owner by email
    Then an invitation record is created (design shared with kanbus-b2ddb4) and accepting it with the invited Google identity creates the owner membership; until then the account has no member and no one can sign in to it
  Scenario: Last-owner rule preserved
    Then an account created this way may hold zero owners only while the first invitation is pending; membership rules are otherwise unchanged
  Scenario: Non-operator
    Given a signed-in account owner or a read-only operator
    Then creation is refused with 403 and nothing is written

Done looks like: central route POST /v1/account-directory/operator/accounts gated by accounts:admin:write; the account creation code path accepts an operator creator (durable-accounts.ts creation fingerprint gains an actor kind); staff BFF route; a CRM admin page under Serve > Accounts with Create account, Grant product (buttons, not dropdowns) and Invite owner, Lucide icons (building-2, key-round, user-plus).

Data touched: account documents (new creator kind), accounts/operator-grants.json (new permission), invitation records (shared with kanbus-b2ddb4).

Specs: features/operator-account-setup.feature; accounts/operator-create.test.ts; directory tests that the route is invisible to google-direct registrations.

Needs Ryan's concrete approval before deployment: the new permission and its first grant, and the API Gateway resource policy change that also unblocks kanbus-592fbb. Relates to kanbus-59284c (provisioning API), which this story partly covers from the operator side.
